acceptanceCriteria: Each listed site signals before the reap or carries a documented, tested reason; a regression test per changed site; the audit outcome for the three audit-only sites is recorded.
body:
Found during V1-0373 (batch L, 2026-10-08, Core v1 line at origin/main 38fcf067). After V1-0373 the groupreap adopters signal before the reap, but other spawners still signal a group after Wait has collected the leader, so a recycled group ID can be signalled or misjudged.

Sites (paths at 38fcf067):
- cmd/corvint/work_runner.go:200 defers workKillGroup(command) after command.Wait() (work_process_unix.go).
- internal/tasks/store/pool_process_unix.go:125 probes, then kills after the reap (check-then-act).
- internal/releasegate/git_unix.go processGroupGone sends signal 0 to the group after the reap; harmless but can falsely refuse on group-ID reuse.
- Needs a pre-reap audit: internal/tasks/store/gate_process_unix.go killGate, internal/tasks/dispatch/process_unix.go:111, and the kill(-pid) sites in dashboard/repository and opencodequalification.

Expected: every group signal is sent while the leader is still unreaped (waitid WNOWAIT, as groupreap does), or the site documents why the post-reap signal cannot hit a reused group. Actual: post-reap signals at the sites above.

Independent review of b2a0b8c6..032246d2 (2026-10-09; installed Core rc.2 build 360, Tasks build 202):
P2: new WaitResidue reuses Darwin QuietProof, which maps kill(-pgid,0) EPERM to ProbeQuiet. XNU killpg1 skips zombies and returns EPERM when no member is signalable, including live members denied by credentials/MAC. With those members closing inherited pipes and a successful leader exit, WaitResidue returns false and the work runner can pass. Expected: ambiguous permission failure is residue/unproved; distinguish zombie-only groups with a process-table observation. Source witness: internal/groupreap/groupreap_unix.go:35-43 and owner_waitid.go:25-35; apple-oss-distributions/xnu bsd/kern/kern_sig.c killpg1_callback/killpg1. This is a source-confirmed ambiguity inherited by the new API, not a live privileged fixture reproduction. Acceptance: separate zombie-only and denied-live-member tests, preserve fail-closed result.
P2 test gap: TestV11036PoolPostReapObservationSendsNoGroupKill records only poolGroupSignal calls. Original removed post-reap calls were syscall.Kill and killGate, neither routed through that seam; restoring those exact calls bypasses its kill assertion. Expected: negative control restores original code without additionally rerouting it. Build-log discrimination claim requires that qualification. Source inspection only; no unsafe raw post-reap mutant executed.
Validation: focused Darwin tests and race tests pass for all five packages; Linux/Windows cross-builds pass; FreeBSD library builds pass but command build hits unrelated internal/cem/publish openBoundedInput undefined. Linux runtime NOT_RUN. No implementation changed by review.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#749 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/749; landed by batch PR #789); on main at 00dd220753973cd7eb332b3b7572db4a2ca60265 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/789). Tests named in the PR: TestPGOV0009* and V1-1036 regressions; groupreap/tasks/releasegate packages. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: Remaining process-group signals after the leader reap: work runner, pool probe, release gate
